title: New Application Ideas of Dynamics 365 Business Central (2025 JUL)
summary: A compilation of feature improvement ideas for Dynamics 365 Business Central submitted by the community, organized by functional areas including development, sales, finance, inventory, manufacturing, and warehousing. This serves as a collection of enhancement requests gathered for the July 2025 release cycle.
key_points: Community-submitted feature ideas span multiple Business Central modules and functions
Suggestions cover development capabilities like native gRPC support and event handling
Finance improvements include approval workflows, VAT handling, and cost accounting enhancements
Inventory and manufacturing ideas address variant models, lot filtering, and consumption controls
General improvements requested include performance optimization, permission management, and UI enhancements

quotes.text: Would any of these ideas improve Business Central? Here is a list of some of them.
quotes.why_it_matters: Frames the post as a collection of user-suggested improvements to evaluate for potential product development
